review_status: Titles, gazette dates and numbers copied from the publishing bodies' own pages on 2026-10-10. Reference only. Pending review by a Turkish mechanical and a Turkish electrical engineer.
description: The documents a mechanical and electrical installation contractor in Türkiye is asked to work to. The general technical specifications are published by the Yüksek Fen Kurulu Başkanlığı of the Çevre, Şehircilik ve İklim Değişikliği Bakanlığı, part by part, in the Resmî Gazete; public contracts make them binding and private contracts usually cite them. This document lists the parts with their gazette dates so that a submittal or a specification clause can name the right one. Nothing here is executed by the validation engine.
